_comment: VPS runtime settings. Secrets stay in .env.
_yadisk_folder_comment: Active event media folder. Session notifications arrive through yadisk_control_folder/to_vps.
_yadisk_control_folder_comment: Stable private bus with only to_booth and to_vps. Processed command and response JSON files are deleted. Must match the photobooth config.

archive_delivery._comment: Independent automatic media archive circuits for completed sessions and accepted remote prints.

ai_image_edit._comment: A photo with text starts AI; exactly ИИ opens the effect menu. AI is available in cafe mode too. IMAGE_API_KEY stays in .env. Landscape sources use 1536x1024; vertical and square sources use 1024x1536.

templates.prompt: Preserve the recognizable identities, ages, facial features, skin tones and expressions of the main subjects in the foreground. Turn the photo into an authentic candid 1990s party snapshot taken on a point-and-shoot 35mm film camera with a harsh direct on-camera flash: bright flash-lit faces, slightly darker background falloff, natural film grain, warm faded colors and a subtle light leak at one edge. Add a small orange digital camera date stamp in the bottom right corner. Keep clothing, hairstyles and setting believable for a fun 90s celebration. It must look like a real scanned film print, not a digital filter. Do not generate any other text, logos or watermarks.

Preserve the recognizable identities, ages, facial features, skin tones and expressions of the main subjects in the foreground. Create a vibrant, festive magazine cover composition. Surround the main subjects with stylish, celebratory Russian text, catchy headlines, and typographic elements that complement their appearance and the holiday mood, wrapping around them beautifully like on a premium lifestyle or fashion magazine cover. Do not generate any unrelated watermarks or logos.

Preserve the recognizable identities, ages, facial features, skin tones and expressions of the main subjects in the foreground. Reimagine them as stylish, collectible toy dolls or action figures packaged inside a premium cardboard toy box with a clear, glossy transparent plastic front window. Arrange themed miniature toy accessories and cool props neatly inside the packaging beside them. The overall presentation should look like a mint-condition, professionally designed retail action figure blister pack.

Preserve the recognizable identities, ages, facial features, skin tones and expressions of the main subjects in the foreground. Redraw the whole scene as a frame from a hand-painted Japanese animated feature film: soft watercolor-like painted backgrounds, lush nature details, warm gentle sunlight, clean expressive linework and a cozy storybook atmosphere. Keep every person clearly recognizable through face shape, hairstyle, clothing and expression. Do not generate any text, letters, logos or watermarks.

Preserve the recognizable identities, ages, facial features, skin tones and expressions of the main subjects in the foreground. Restyle them as a quiet-luxury 'old money' editorial photoshoot: elegant tailored classic outfits in cream, navy, camel and white, pearls or a subtle classic wristwatch, neat polished hair, set on the sunlit terrace of a country estate or in a classic wood-paneled library. Soft natural daylight, refined muted color grading, a medium-format film look and relaxed confident poses. Do not generate any text, letters, logos or watermarks.

Preserve the recognizable identities, ages, facial features, skin tones and expressions of the main subjects in the foreground. Reimagine them in dynamic, glamorous superstar poses with high-fashion clothing, dramatic professional lighting, and an elegant premier event environment. Keep the overall look polished, flattering, and suitable for a premium 10x15 print. Do not generate any text, letters, logos or watermarks.

Preserve the recognizable identities, ages, facial features, skin tones and expressions of the main subjects in the foreground. Transform the photo into a museum-quality classical oil painting portrait in the manner of the Old Masters: rich chiaroscuro lighting, a dark warm background, visible brushstrokes and canvas texture, period aristocratic clothing with velvet, lace and gold details, and dignified poses. Faces must stay true to the originals. Do not generate any text, letters, logos, picture frames or watermarks.

Preserve the recognizable identities, ages, facial features, skin tones and expressions of the main subjects in the foreground. Reimagine them as iconic figures from a nostalgic Soviet-era postcard or vintage poster. Use authentic cinematic retro lighting, iconic mid-20th-century retro attire, and a warm, slightly grainy, celebratory film-like atmosphere. The composition should look like a cherished, classic artistic postcard from the past.

Preserve the recognizable identities, ages, facial features, skin tones and expressions of the main subjects in the foreground. Reimagine them as characters on a stylish, premium fantasy or superhero collectible gaming card, complete with an elegant, thematic card border. Add minimal, humorous and witty Russian text, funny titles, or silly stat labels integrated seamlessly into the card design, matching the subjects' unique appearance and playful vibe.

Preserve the recognizable identities and key facial features of the main subjects in the foreground. Create one polished three-panel comic composition telling a short celebratory visual story, with consistent character appearance of the main subjects across all panels and clear panel separation. Leave speech areas empty. Do not generate any text, letters, logos or watermarks.
